about: The two-voices conversation again, in a recorded kitchen with a fan, a tap and dishes going.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Did you end up booking the campsite for the long weekend?

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: I did, but only for two nights. The third night was already full.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Two nights is fine. Which site did we get this time?

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: The one near the creek, with the big gum tree over the tent pad.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Nice. I'll dig out the old stove and check how much gas is left.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Last time it ran out halfway through dinner, and we ate cold beans by torchlight.
